chapters.name_zh: 安全、隐私与数据完整性

types.name_zh: 二进制量级与单位前缀
types.summary: 二进制前缀（kibi/mebi/gibi/tebi，按 1024 进）与十进制前缀（kilo/mega/giga/tera，按 1000 进）的区别与换算；n 位能表示多少个不同值、存某个值最少要几位。
cues: kibibyte / mebibyte / gibibyte / tebibyte 与 kilobyte / megabyte / gigabyte / terabyte 并列出现
State (one) difference between a kibibyte and a kilobyte
binary prefix / decimal (denary) prefix
Tick one box to identify the largest file size（混合单位比大小）
State the number of unique binary values that can be represented in n bits
minimum number of bits used to store each example of data
not: P1-IR-03：问补码能表示的最小/最大值 → IR-03
P1-IR-12：在图像/声音情境里算文件大小或颜色数 → IR-12（单位换算只是其中一步）

types.name_zh: 进制转换（无符号与 BCD）
types.name_en: Number base conversion: unsigned binary, denary, hexadecimal and BCD
types.summary: 在无符号二进制、十进制、十六进制、BCD 之间互相转换（含写步骤、填表、连线），以及说明一串位为什么不是合法 BCD。
cues: Convert the unsigned binary integer / hexadecimal number / denary number into …
Convert … into Binary Coded Decimal (BCD) / Convert the BCD into denary

Show your working（进制转换）
State why the value cannot be interpreted as BCD
not: P1-IR-03：题目写明 two's complement / one's complement / 负数 → IR-03
P1-IR-04：问 BCD 或十六进制用在哪里、为什么用 → IR-04
P1-IR-06：必须利用「字符编码连续」才能求出某字符的码值 → IR-06；码值已给、只做进制转换 → IR-02

types.name_zh: 有符号整数：补码与反码
types.name_en: Signed integers: two's complement and one's complement
types.summary: 十进制负数与 n 位补码（或反码）互转、说明转换步骤、n 位补码能表示的最小值与最大值。
cues: two's complement binary integer → denary / denary → n-bit two's complement
one's complement representation
smallest / largest … two's complement … 8 / 12 / 16 bits
Explain how to convert the two's complement integer … into denary
signed denary value −…
not: P1-IR-02：无符号数或 BCD → IR-02
P1-IR-05：要做加减运算（即使用补码做减法）→ IR-05
P1-PF-11：对补码数做算术移位 → PF-11

types.name_zh: BCD 与十六进制的应用
types.summary: 说出 BCD（或十六进制）的一个实际应用并论证为什么在该场合使用，或列举使用 BCD 的好处。
cues: Identify / Give one (practical) application where BCD is used and justify its use
State two benefits of using Binary Coded Decimal (BCD)
Application … Justification 两栏表
why hexadecimal is used（如 MAC 地址、颜色码、错误码）
not: P1-IR-02：只要求转换数值 → IR-02

types.summary: 做 n 位二进制加法或减法（直接借位，或转补码后相加），写出进位/借位过程并标出溢出；解释溢出是什么、为什么会发生。
cues: Add / Perform / Complete the following binary addition. Show your working.
Subtract … using binary subtraction
Include any overflow bit(s)
State what is meant by an overflow / State one reason why … can result in overflow
Name and describe the error that can occur when binary addition is performed
not: P1-IR-03：只转换补码、不做运算 → IR-03
P1-PF-09：汇编情境中执行 ADD/SUB 指令后求 ACC → PF-09

types.name_en: Character sets: ASCII, extended ASCII and Unicode
types.summary: 字符集是什么；文本如何按字符集存成二进制（每个字符有唯一编码、按顺序存放、相邻字符码值连续）；ASCII、扩展 ASCII、Unicode 的位数、可表示字符数、差异与优缺点。
cues: character set / ASCII / extended ASCII / Unicode
Explain how the word '…' / text is represented by a character set
Give two differences / advantages … Unicode … instead of ASCII
number of bits each character set allocates / number of characters that can be represented
The Unicode value for '0' is … Write the value for '5'（利用码值连续）
not: P1-IR-02：字符的码值已经给出，只要求换成另一进制 → IR-02

types.summary: 解释位图如何编码（由像素组成、每像素一种颜色、每种颜色有唯一二进制码、按顺序存放、文件头），定义 pixel、colour/bit depth、image resolution、screen resolution、file header，说出文件头里存什么。
cues: Describe / Explain how the data for a bitmapped image is encoded

P1-IR-12：要算文件大小或最少位深 → IR-12
P1-IR-09：矢量图术语 → IR-09

types.name_en: Effects of changing bitmap resolution and colour depth
types.summary: 说明提高或降低图像分辨率、色深对图像质量（细节、像素化、颜色数）和文件大小的影响与原因，或指出可以改哪些参数来减小文件。
cues: Explain / Describe the effect of increasing / decreasing the bit depth / colour depth / image resolution
Effect on image … Effect on image file / image quality … file size

P1-IR-15：把降低色深当作有损压缩方法来描述 → IR-15

types.name_zh: 矢量图及与位图的比较
types.name_en: Vector graphics and bitmap vs vector
types.summary: 矢量图如何编码（drawing object、property、drawing list）及术语定义与举例；位图与矢量图的差异，为给定任务选择其一并论证。

Describe the contents of a vector graphic drawing list
differences between a vector graphic and a bitmap image
benefits of creating a vector graphic instead of a bitmap image

types.summary: 解释声音如何数字化（模拟声波、按固定时间间隔测量振幅、每个样本存为二进制数），定义 sampling、sampling rate、sampling resolution、analogue data。
cues: Describe how sound is represented / encoded in a computer
Explain how an analogue sound wave is converted into digital data
State what is meant by sampling rate / sampling resolution / analogue data
Describe what is meant by a sampling rate of 44.1 kHz
Complete the table by giving the term for each description about sound
not: P1-IR-11：问改变采样率/分辨率的影响 → IR-11
P1-IR-12：算声音文件大小 → IR-12

types.name_en: Effects of changing sampling rate and sampling resolution
types.summary: 说明提高或降低采样率、采样分辨率对录音准确度（与原声的接近程度）和文件大小的影响及原因。
cues: Explain the effect of increasing / decreasing the sampling rate / sampling resolution
on the accuracy / precision of the (sound) recording / on the file size
Describe the reasons why the sound is closer to the original when a higher sample rate is used

P1-IR-15：把降低采样率当作压缩方法来描述 → IR-15

types.name_zh: 多媒体文件大小与位深计算
types.name_en: Multimedia calculations: file size, bit depth and number of colours
types.summary: 用 宽×高×色深（视频再 × 帧数 × 秒数；声音为 采样率 × 采样分辨率 × 时长）估算文件大小并换算成要求的单位；由颜色数求最少位深，或由位数求最多颜色数。
cues: Calculate (an estimate for) the file size … Show your working
Give your answer in megabytes / mebibytes / kibibytes / bytes
pixels wide … pixels high … bit depth / colour depth
frames … per second / sampling rate … sampling resolution … minutes
Identify the smallest bit depth / smallest number of bits … for the image shown
State the largest number of different colours that can be represented by n bits

P1-IR-08：只定性说影响、不计算 → IR-08

types.summary: 说明在给定场景中压缩文件的理由与好处（占用存储更少、传输/下载更快、占用带宽更少、满足附件大小限制），或说明为什么某场景不需要压缩。
cues: Explain the reasons why … is compressed (before it is transmitted / attached to an email)
Explain the benefits … of the attachment being a compressed file

Explain the reasons for compressing the files

P1-IR-15：问怎样压缩 → IR-15

types.name_zh: 有损与无损：选择与论证
types.name_en: Lossy vs lossless compression: choose and justify
types.summary: 区分有损与无损压缩，为给定文件（文本、照片、实时视频、声音）选择更合适的一种并论证，或判断某种做法属于哪一种。
cues: Identify whether the lossy or lossless compression method is more appropriate … Justify your answer

State whether this is lossless or lossy compression. Justify your choice.
not: P1-IR-13：只问为什么要压缩 → IR-13
P1-IR-15：描述具体压缩方法 → IR-15

types.name_en: Compression methods: RLE and lossy techniques
types.summary: 描述文本、位图、声音的具体压缩方法：游程编码 RLE（能按 RLE 编码/解码一串数据，说明何时不省空间）；有损方法如降低色深/分辨率/采样率、去掉人听不到的声音。
cues: Describe / Explain how … can be compressed using run-length encoding (RLE)

P1-SS-02：只问压缩实用软件的用途 → SS-02

types.summary: 联网的好处；LAN 与 WAN 的特征与区别（地理范围、基础设施归谁、传输介质），为情境选择 LAN 或 WAN 并论证。

types.name_zh: 网络模型：客户端-服务器、对等网、瘦/胖客户端
types.name_en: Network models: client-server, peer-to-peer, thin and thick client

types.summary: 总线、星型、网状、混合拓扑的结构特点、优缺点比较、按语句勾选拓扑、为情境选择拓扑并论证，以及画出或补全拓扑连接图。

P1-CM-05：只问交换机/路由器的作用 → CM-05

types.summary: 交换机、集线器、服务器、NIC、WNIC、无线接入点 WAP、网桥、中继器的用途；路由器的作用（接收数据包、读目的 IP、选路转发、连接不同网络/接入互联网）。
